html: <span class="item-box -gem"><span class="header -single"><span class="symbol"></span>Lightning Warp<span class="symbol"></span></span><span class="item-stats"><span class="group ">[[Spell (gem tag)|Spell]], [[AoE (gem tag)|AoE]], [[Lightning (gem tag)|Lightning]], [[Duration (gem tag)|Duration]], [[Remnant (gem tag)|Remnant]], [[Repeatable (gem tag)|Repeatable]]<br>Tier: <em class="tc -value ">9</em><br>Level: <em class="tc -value ">(1-20)</em><br>Cost: <em class="tc -value ">(8-83) Mana</em><br>Cast Time: <em class="tc -value ">0.50 sec</em><br>Critical Strike Chance: <em class="tc -value ">11.00%</em></span><span class="group tc -gemdesc">Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the [[Cull]] threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a [[Debuff]] to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the [[Cull]] threshold during its duration.
